newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND MAKES STRONG COMEBACK IN ARGENTINA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND MAKES STRONG COMEBACK IN ARGENTINA.

text.p: England made a strong comeback on Tuesday with a convincing 58-17 victory against the Argentina "A" squad in its third friendly match in Argentina.
Darren O'Leary, one of the player's left out of Sunday's match against Buenos Aires which ended in a 23-21 defeat, started off the roll, scoring a try just five minutes into the match.
O'Leary became the game's top scorer after another two tries just 10 minutes apart in the second half that was completely dominated by England.

The score was 24-17 at halftime, but more tries by Haag, Baxendell and Catt in the second half contributed to the solid score, which should put the side in confident mood when they meet the Pumas in the first of two tests on Saturday.
England also beat Argentine champions Cordoba 38-21 last Wednesday.
The England squad has been sapped by the British Lions, who have taken 18 players on their tour of South Africa.
England - Tries: O'Leary (3), Baxendell (2), Gomarsall, Haag, Catt. Conversions: Mapletoft (4), Baxendell. Penalties: Mapletoft.
Argentina A - Tries: Viel, Legora, Cilley. Conversions: Cilley.
